all.title: File:Interior, Catholic Church, Mykonos, Greece (53505695907).jpg
all.author: Warren LeMay from Chicago, IL, United States
all.description: Built in 1668-1677, this Cycladic-style church was constructed as a Catholic Church by the Venetians, which ruled over Mykonos until the early 1700s.  The church features a limewashed exterior, a cross-gable roof, a limewashed campanile, roman arched window bays, and a dome at the crossing of the roof.  The building today is the only significant Catholic Church on the island of Mykonos.
